title: Weirdo-Mod
description: Weird mod that adds destroyer of world, cheese, and more.
body:
**IMPORTANT: Please read the description! As it has information that is required to play.**

This mod adds lot's of different things, like cheese, a villager profession, destroyer of worlds, and Jerry... We do not talk about Jerry...

First of all, how do I play?

It would be a good idea to say something in chat in order to summon a Knowledger, what is a knowledger? A knowledger is a mob designed to help you out with how to get to the Destroyer of worlds to spawn in.

Also btw, when the knowledger says cook the milk bucket, in reality instead just get a crafting table, put a milk bucket in the center, and you'll get cheese.

![A scientist that has a red eye at the right, a normal eye at the left, overgrown hair, and a grayish + brown clothing.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2eca0f926c54186fb55fabe81514ff9f04f325b1.png)

The destroyer of worlds is an eldritch horror, or more like instead just an eldritch annoying ant bite, that tries to track you down, fly to you, and if you are mining down to safety, it'll just create falling tnt or "FALLING TNTA!!! >:)".

![A flying minecraft totem.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/70730c054adf2107982a2387a1899072cb4ed508.png)

A weirdo villager is a villager that gives important items to you in order to spawn in a destroyer of worlds, like a destroyer of worlds spawn egg.

![A weirdo villager that seems like a millionaire but isn't actually.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2tJ3QVAM/images/fd74a11266ce89de6e9aba2c4b4f3fcf71df15ce_350.webp)

HOWEVER! BE WARNED!!! :`(
Weirdo **zombie** villagers look almost indentical to normal weirdo villagers, SO WATCH OUT!!!

![Weirdo zombie villager with green zombie hands.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2tJ3QVAM/images/3a116a53ddc798ad8abdeb0b38c01195a99d4fa7_350.webp)
